body:
After you order, a private page tracks everything about your order. It needs no account and no password, only the link in your email. On it you can see your order ID, the amount due, the current status, the payment details for your method, an upload box for proof and a WhatsApp button. It is the single place to follow an order from payment to delivery. This guide walks through every part of the page, explains what each section is for, how to use the copy buttons and the upload box on a phone, what to do if the page does not open, how it keeps your order private and how it connects with your emails. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Opening the page
Use the link in your confirmation or payment email. The link includes a unique token, so keep it to yourself: anyone with the link can view the order. You do not need to sign in or create an account. Bookmark the page on your phone or computer, or keep the email, so that you can return at any time. If you placed the order through WhatsApp, the link is also in your confirmation email.

## The summary
At the top you see your order ID, the amount due and the current status. The order ID, such as OSV-XXXXXX, is the reference you give us in any message. The amount due shows the total after any discount and including shipping. The status shows where the order is: awaiting payment, payment details sent, proof submitted, payment detected, payment confirmed, shipped or cancelled. See [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/) for what each means and what to do.

## The items and totals
Below the summary you can see the items you ordered, with the option you chose, such as strength or pack size, the quantity and the line price. The totals show the subtotal, any discount for crypto or gift cards, shipping and the total. Check these against what you expected. If anything is wrong, contact us straight away, before you pay. See [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/).

## Payment details
The page shows payment details according to the method you chose.

### Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime
Each detail appears in its own box with a tap-to-copy button. Tap the button, switch to your payment app and paste. You will see the amount to pay and the note to include, which is your order ID. Pay the exact amount. See the guides for [Cash App](/blog/cash-app-payments-guide/), [Apple Pay](/blog/apple-pay-payments-guide/) and [Chime](/blog/chime-payments-guide/).

### Cryptocurrency
You see the wallet address, the network, the amount and a QR code, plus an automatic status checker that tells you when a payment is detected and confirmed. Copy the address with the copy button, and check the network before you send. See [how to pay with Bitcoin](/blog/how-to-pay-with-bitcoin/) and [how we detect your crypto payment](/blog/how-we-detect-your-crypto-payment/).

### Gift cards
You see the buy link for your card and the steps to follow, with an upload box for the code and receipt. See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/).

## Uploading proof
Use the upload box to add screenshots, receipt photos or gift card photos. You can add up to four images, and they are compressed on your device before they are sent, so large photos upload quickly. You can add a transaction hash or a card code and a note. Wait for the confirmation that the upload succeeded before you close the page. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/) for tips on clear images.

## The WhatsApp link
A button opens WhatsApp with a message about your order if you prefer chat. The message includes your order reference, so that we find the order immediately. Use it for questions, and use the upload box for proof. See [ordering via WhatsApp](/blog/ordering-via-whatsapp/).

## Tracking
After your order ships, the page shows that it has shipped, and the tracking email has the carrier and number. Use the carrier's page for the latest movement. See [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/).

## If the page says "not found"
The link may be incomplete. Copy the whole link from the email, including the part after the question mark, because the token is what opens the page. Some email programs break long links across lines, so try copying it again, or open it from a different device. If it still does not work, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID, and we will send a fresh link.

## If the page looks out of date
Refresh the page. Statuses change as events happen, and the page shows the latest. If it still looks wrong, for example you paid but it says awaiting payment, wait a few minutes and check again, then contact us if it has not changed. Some payments are confirmed by a person, which takes longer outside business hours.

## Using the page on a phone
The page works on any phone. Use the copy buttons to paste into your payment app, switch back to the page to upload proof and use the screenshot function on your phone to capture the confirmation. If you use two devices, you can open the link on both, as long as you keep it private.

## Privacy
Do not share the link. Only people with it can view the order, and it shows your items, your totals and your payment status. If you think someone else has seen it, contact us. Read about [privacy](/blog/why-we-need-your-email-and-phone/) and see our [privacy policy](/privacy/). We never ask for passwords, PINs, private keys or recovery phrases on the page or anywhere else.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### How long does the link work?
It works for as long as the order exists in our records, so you can return to it for tracking and questions. If it stops working, we can send a fresh link.

### Can I change my order from the page?
The page is for following and paying. To change an order, contact us with your order ID.

### Does the page show my full address?
It shows what you need to confirm the order. Your delivery details are stored with the order and used for shipping.

### Is the page secure on public Wi-Fi?
The site uses HTTPS. As a general habit, avoid entering sensitive information on networks you do not trust, and do not share the link.

### What if I have two orders?
Each order has its own page and link. Use the right link for the right order, and quote the order ID when you contact us.

## Related
Start with [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) and [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Walkthrough: a Cash App order from the page
You open the private link from your email on your phone. The summary shows OSV-A1B2C3, the amount of $195.00 and the status payment details sent. You scroll to the payment details. The $Cashtag has a copy button, so you tap it. You switch to the Cash App, paste the handle, enter 195.00 and type your order ID in the note. You confirm and take a screenshot of the receipt. You return to the page, tap the upload box, choose the screenshot, add a short note saying the payment was sent at 3:20pm and tap send. The page confirms the upload and the status changes to proof submitted. A few minutes later, we confirm the payment, you receive an email and the status becomes payment confirmed.

## Walkthrough: a crypto order from the page
You choose USDT on Tron at checkout, and the page shows the address, the network and the amount. You copy the address, check the network label and open your wallet. You paste the address, enter the amount and confirm. Back on the page, the status checker shows payment sent, then detected and then confirmed. You do not have to upload anything unless we ask. If the status stays on waiting, you add the transaction hash in the upload box and contact us.

## Troubleshooting the upload box
If the upload box will not accept an image, check the file type, because common image formats work best, and check the size. Try a screenshot instead of a photo, or crop it. If it still fails, switch network between Wi-Fi and mobile data, and try again. If nothing works, email the image to us from the address on your order with your order ID, and we will attach it to the order.

## Frequently asked questions about using the page
### Why does the status not change when I pay?
Some statuses change automatically, such as a crypto payment being detected, while others are updated by a person after a check, such as an app or gift card payment. Upload your proof, and allow time in business hours.

### Can I use the page after the order is delivered?
Yes. It remains a record of your order, with the items, totals and status. If it stops working, we can send a fresh link.

### Does the page work in any browser?
Yes, on any modern browser on a phone, tablet or computer. If something does not display correctly, try refreshing or opening the link in another browser.

faq.a: No. The page needs only the private link in your email, which contains a unique token.

faq.a: See your order ID, items, totals and status, copy payment details, view crypto payment status, upload proof and open WhatsApp.
Use the upload box to add up to four images, plus a transaction hash or card code and a note. Wait for the success message.

faq.a: Copy the whole link from the email, including the part after the question mark. If it still fails, contact us for a fresh link.
Only people with the link can view the order, so do not share it.

faq.a: No. Contact us with your order ID to change or cancel an order.
